brief:
Hamas issued a formal condolence statement Sunday following the death of Palestinian Ambassador to Egypt Diab al-Louh, the Shehab Wire reported. Al-Louh held the diplomatic post representing Palestinian interests in Cairo at the Arab Republic of Egypt's capital.

The Islamic Resistance Movement's tribute marked the passing of a senior Palestinian envoy who served as a key diplomatic channel between the Palestinian Authority and the Egyptian government during a period of significant regional tension and ongoing conflict.
title: Hamas mourns Palestinian ambassador to Egypt Diab al-Louh
